title: Kenworth T610 SAR Radar Compatable FUPS compliant Road Train Custom Built Aluminium Bullbar #102
description: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS high tensile polished aluminium Bullbar. Three main, one piece 76mm cross tubes through drilled uprights and recessed into drilled outer uprights (optional 88 or 100mm tubes on request). 100mm box uprights shown with outer uprights. Heavy duty backing plate with 38mm tow pin, Optional hi-tensile aluminium backing plate available on request giving up to an 80kg saving over the steel backing plate. Reversible Road Train / Long Vehicle signs with polished aluminium covers plus Dangerous Goods book on aluminium mounting plate. LED indicator/Park/Daylight Running lights mounted in main channel. Optional flat bar extension fitted to bottom of the main channel. Driving light mounts to customer spec. Front mudflap mounts on rear of main channel. Bull bar can be custom built to your specifications.
